methodology.capm_alpha: OLS excess-return intercept * periods_per_year; beta requires varying benchmark
methodology.cash: buy at first grid close; entitlement captured ex-date before same-day pay-date reinvestment; paid cash within grid window
methodology.correlation: pairwise common declared intervals; minimum 3; chronological floor(70%) train / remainder OOS; no driver promotion
methodology.currency: exact-date direct/inverse spot; no triangulation, carry or leverage
methodology.expense_ratio: point-in-time disclosure only; NAV fees are not deducted again
methodology.fees: proportional deductions once per named transaction; FX fee on initial foreign purchase and paid cash conversion; reinvestment fee on pay-date purchase
methodology.paid_yield: 365-day paid per-unit base-currency payouts / ending split-adjusted market price in base currency; paid_income excludes ROC and unknown classification
methodology.payout_statistics: CV population stdev / mean of observed pay-date per-unit base-currency payouts; cuts / adjacent observed payouts, including ROC
methodology.price_total_return: (end split-adjusted price + interval ex-date payouts) / start price - 1; no intra-interval reinvestment assumed
methodology.regimes: fresh records whose economic as_of and availability UTC date both equal interval start; available by midnight start; no label carry; delayed legacy records may have no segments; explicit instrument.market must match; stale source flags preserved
methodology.return_grid: declared adjacent intervals; consecutive monthly calendar months or daily gaps <=14 calendar days; producer verifies exchange sessions; CAGR uses elapsed days/365.25; no filling or gap bridging
methodology.sharpe: arithmetic mean excess period return / sample stdev * sqrt(periods_per_year); compounded annual risk-free conversion
methodology.sortino: all-interval root mean square negative excess return; arithmetic mean excess numerator
methodology.taxes: uniform user withholding scenario applied to all payouts; no capital-gain liquidation tax inferred
methodology.total_return_index: index ratios already include distributions; no additions
methodology.tracking_difference: fund compounded total return minus benchmark compounded total return over full grid
